# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# read cleaned csv files 
```{r read_files, include=FALSE}
source("customized_functions/read_files_by_path.R")
path <- "../data/cleaned"
cleaned_tables <- read_files_by_path(directory_path = path)
```
```{r cleaned_schema}
library(dm)
list2env(cleaned_tables, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Create dm object from the list of data frames
dm_obj <- dm(activity_daily, calories_hourly, calories_minute, heartrate_second,
             intensities_hourly, intensities_minute, mets_minute, sleep_minute,
             steps_hourly, steps_minute, weight_NA)
diagram <- dm_draw(dm_obj, view_type="all",column_types = TRUE)
diagram
```
